title: Henkel's clutch threes and McDaniel's 21 off the bench seal Enovos League title for Etzella
description: Etzella Ettelbruck are the 2025-26 Enovos League champions, holding off a furious Sparta Bertrange rally 87-81 in Game 3 at the Centre sportif du Deich on Sunday to complete a 3-0 sweep of the best-of-five finals before 950 fans. It looked comfortable for 30 minutes. Then it looked like it was slipping away. Then Thomas Henkel (190-G-1993) buried two clutch three-pointers down the stretch that silenced Sparta's comeback and sent Ettelbruck into delirium.
